hypothesis: Strong student-consistent cues lacking teacher original-tile support may receive teacher corroboration in two recentered contexts
proposal_rule: Existing student_consistent variant additions not overlapping accepted cross_model_supported selection; at most 6
teacher_context: Same frozen two distinct 1280px windows, shifts -160/+160; prediction960; each same-class score > .75; each box IoU >= .5 with student seed and pair IoU >= .5
selection: Preserve all accepted teacher and cross-model student cues; append original student seed geometry only, in remaining supplementary slots
training_acceptance: 32 train controls: more than 67/98 TP, unmatched 0, normal cues 0; otherwise reject and do not evaluate heldouts
holdout_acceptance: inner more than61/80, unmatched0; outer>=31/56, unmatched<=1; no normal cues increase
